authority.truth: CoreRPG is sole WorldState writer and authoritative adjudicator; fixture accepted facts are unsigned and synthetic
authority.needs: B01–B08 own causal consequences and accepted needs; B08 projections are not accepted needs
authority.crisis: B08 does not invent needs/missions; accepted external consequences may later result in a need
authority.economy: B04 owns resources, inventory, trade and allocation
authority.science: B06 owns research and certified capabilities
authority.anomalies: B07 owns physical anomalies and archaeology
authority.war: B03 owns military actions and effects
authority.missions: B09 screens mission candidates and records non-authoritative mission lifecycle proof only
authority.scheduler: B10 will own background event evaluation, not a B09 tick loop
authority.authority_and_session: F11 and HOST enforce authentication, orders, chain of command and player/NPC permissions; fixture grants are not live credentials
authority.execution: CoreRPG commands, independent facts, save/load and UE5 gameplay are not implemented here
authority.narrative: Scripted seasons and mission templates are separate; seasonal arcs never manufacture WorldState need to force B09 offer

source_requirements.need: Externally accepted campaign-scoped need with already accepted consequence cause, time, requester, existing location, existing open route, required capabilities and classification
source_requirements.forbidden_origin: Risk/exposure projections, camera distance, player availability, quest dramatic pressure or unapproved policy
source_requirements.fact_maturity: Fixture status accepted is a synthetic input and does not provide a trusted CoreRPG signature
source_requirements.need_resolution: Only an accepted independent need_resolved fact establishes resolution; no auto-close when player clicks

required: accepted need and accepted consequence not future
actor scope propose and delivered or previously granted knowledge
real available asset with required capabilities
existing route open and ending at need location
asset not already assigned in reference
asset location matches existing route origin
one concurrent assigned resource response per accepted need in reference

lifecycle.authorize: Independent accepted order naming mission, need, asset, responsible actor, jurisdiction, approved by separate issuer; prewarp needs independent approved_exception policy
lifecycle.assign: Separate accepted order and separate accepted reservation, real available and qualified asset, no concurrent assigned same asset; no reservation created here; verified route origin equals asset location; reject parallel assignment against same need
lifecycle.complete: Verified independent outcome_report for exact mission AND independently accepted need_resolved fact; rewards/migrations not written
lifecycle.cancel: Accepted external cancellation decision; an already resolved need prevents further dispatch but does not rewrite prior mission history
lifecycle.knowledge: Only delivered, clearance-compatible historical snapshots; a late message may remain stale

prime_directive.prewarp_intervention: hard refusal without accepted specific approved_exception even during emergency
prime_directive.contact_authority: no automatic contact by warp threshold or rescue

determinism.canonical_json: sort_keys, UTF-8, compact separators, no NaN
determinism.record_digest: SHA-256 per local event record; not CoreRPG signatures
determinism.idempotence: same ID and body no-op even on later replay; collision raises
determinism.ordering: monotonic tick >= cutoff except exact replay
determinism.atomicity: failed request never modifies supplied state

forbidden: Generating stock shortages, injuries, NPC distress or anomalies just to spawn missions
Treating projected B08 pressures as accepted humanitarian needs
Auto-granting rank authority, Federation permissions, Prime Directive exceptions or external reservations
Forcing Enterprise-D/player involvement or success; no teleportation or phantom ship routes
Awarding credits, technology, commendations or loot in reference simulation
Claiming the Python reducer starts gameplay quests, NPCs, B10 scheduler or persistent CoreRPG events
runtime_gates: CoreRPG signed accepted facts, event ownership and true session scope
F11 + HOST order and command issuer verification
Real B04 stock, logistics, route, availability and reservation integration
B01-B08 factual need production with unchanged authority
B10 offscreen scheduler, missed ticks, fair multi-agent mission arbitrator and durable replay
Persisted conflict checks, migrations, cancellation and stale-status correction
UE5 mission screens, logs, reward handling, NPC dispatch, PADD privacy and end-to-end tests
